module.name: Docs
module.purpose: Canonical scrolls, specifications, rituals, and metadata for the TFT 3Pack. Defines symbolic structure (.fff spec, output logic, test suite), preserves glyph lifecycle metadata (registries, retirement logs, echo logs, reawakening traces), codifies contributor rituals (codex forks, tribute flames, fusion ceremonies), and houses protocol specifications (Nawderian theorem, ENTFT keygen, protocol manifests).

modules_linked: fff_spec.md ↔ formats/ — format specification ↔ example .fff files
outputs_spec.md ↔ tft/output_manager.py — output logic spec ↔ runtime implementation
TriadicTestSuite.md ↔ tft/cli_test_suite.py — test spec ↔ test implementation
QUICKSTART.md → all modules — general onboarding entry point
_meta/ → tft/entft/registry/ — glyph metadata mirrors ↔ runtime registries
illustrations/ → README documentation — SVG layer diagrams for entft, nous, tops
_svg/ → tft/entft/ — glyph lifecycle visualizations (fusion, reawakening, retirement, echo)
session_context.drift: medium (glyph lifecycle metadata evolves: retirement logs, echo traces, reawakening events)
session_context.format: markdown + json + yaml + python + svg + html

structural_grammar.regime_envelope: R1–R2 (R2: glyph lifecycle governance adds regime-level tracking)
structural_grammar.coherence_envelope: C1–C3 (spec compliance → ritual consistency → cross-registry coherence)

four_pillars.scrolls: Root-level specs (fff_spec, outputs_spec, TriadicTestSuite, QUICKSTART) — canonical definitions
four_pillars.meta: _meta/ — glyph lifecycle registries, retirement logs, echo traces, validator configs
four_pillars.rituals: _rituals/ — codex forks, tribute flames, reawakening ceremonies, runtime hooks, TFT bundles
four_pillars.specs: _specs/ — protocol specifications, Nawderian theorem/constants, keygen simulator, artist echo profiles

imports: tft-3pack (parent module — dimensional envelope, audience, canon context)
entft (glyph lifecycle registries, scroll system, protocol-core engines)
formats (.fff file format spec mirrored in fff_spec.md)
